task: binary classification of peptides as skin sensitizer (positive) vs non-sensitizer; P(sensitizer) in [0, 1], the mean of four member probabilities, called sensitizer at >= 0.55 (fixed)
architecture: equal-weight soft vote of RandomForest (500 trees, min_samples_leaf 2), LDA, RBF SVC and an MLP (14-480-200-64-1, BatchNorm + GELU, dropout 0.5), all trained with sensitizers weighted 5x
input: peptide sequence (+ optional modifications) -> SMILES -> 14 RDKit/alert features
weights_layout: RF.joblib, LDA.joblib, SVM.joblib (sklearn pipelines), MLP.pt (joblib dict: state, scaler, n_in, p_drop)

training_data.note: mostly small molecules; 25 peptides (9 positive); the other 24 peptides were held out

validation_metrics.source: Models/SkinSense/training.ipynb, 24 held-out peptides, exploratory (set already inspected)
validation_metrics.caveat: 0.55 was explored for the RF on the held-out peptides, not validated for this ensemble
